name: print-social-red-stadium-concert-stage-key-visual
title: Red stadium concert stage with giant LED screens and a lit crowd
whatItIs: A rendered stage design in saturated red with a huge central script logo on an LED wall, two side screens with '24H' text, a lit catwalk and runway, and a dense crowd with phone lights in the foreground.
whatItMeans: Loud and immersive; one brand colour floods the space so the brand becomes the venue.
techniques: Flood an entire scene with one brand colour.
Use a giant logo as the stage backdrop.
Line screens and lights to draw a central perspective.
Show the crowd as small lit dots.

vocabulary.definition: Making an entire scene one brand colour.
A large screen made from LED panels.
A composition converging on one point.
The main image representing a campaign.
